_note: THE APPS SHELF'S TRUST ANCHOR (studio-apps.md §11): the Ed25519 public key every approval record verifies against. THIS IS THE DEV KEY - its private half sits in OpenSource/Conformance/studio-apps/approval.json as a test fixture, in the open, on purpose, so both signature runners can round-trip deterministically. It approves NOTHING real: the production key is minted OFFLINE at the owner ceremony (ClosedSource/Documentation/v4-launch/registry/01-apps-shelf.md, the PUBLISH.md entitlement-signer discipline - the key never enters CI or this repository), and a release replaces this file with the production public half. Verification fails closed either way: an approval signed by any other key is refused with the reason named.
